indices.title: Wednesday close: Nasdaq edged higher; S&P slipped
indices.body: The Nasdaq Composite gained 0.2% to 26,861.06, while the S&P 500 fell 0.3% to 7,651.54. The Dow lost 0.9% and the Russell 2000 fell 0.4%. Wednesday was month-end and quarter-end; market breadth remained weak.

earnings.title: NIKE (NKE) · after the close
earnings.body: NIKE plans to release fiscal Q1 2027 results at approximately 4:15 p.m. ET on Thursday, October 1; its call is scheduled for 5:00 p.m. ET.

news.title: Micron posts record quarter and raises its outlook
news.body: Micron reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23B and non-GAAP EPS of $33.42. Its fiscal Q1 outlook calls for revenue of $61.5B ± $1.5B and non-GAAP EPS of $38.15 ± $1.00.

news.title: PCE comes in below expectations; growth revised higher
news.body: August PCE inflation rose 3.4% year over year versus a 3.7% Reuters poll estimate, while final Q2 GDP was revised to 2.2%. Softer inflation and firmer growth leave the rate outlook in focus.
